independent.aeon: Aeon >=1.4 requires scipy<1.18; the shared core pins scipy 1.18.1.
independent.cobrapy: Current Cobra requires pandas<3; the shared core pins pandas 3.0.5.
independent.bioservices: BioServices 1.16 requires wrapt<2; the core pins wrapt 2.4.0.
independent.scvelo: Full scVelo 0.3.4 algorithms need older NumPy/Pandas despite permissive metadata.
independent.pysam: PySAM 0.24.0 has no Windows wheel; use a supported Linux environment.
independent.etetoolkit: ETE4 4.4.0 has no Windows wheel; native compilation is outside this portable profile.
independent.tiledbvcf: Requires a separately validated platform/ABI environment.
independent.vaex: Requires a separately validated Windows ABI environment.
